==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A pink glowing storm cloud appeared in the sky. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
From it emerged a glass elemental with a desire to subjugate or destroy all humans. (Pink Glass Elemental resembled a woman made of pink glass with an hourglass figure, a white heart shaped symbol on the center of her chest, large glowing empty white eyes, and glass hair that seemed to float weightlessly.) (She seemed to perceive humans as lesser to magical creatures and she hated how much influence I had over the Elven Village. In many ways her philosophy felt like the opposite of the Death Witch, who believed that humans should rule over the magical world of the Elven Village.) (Pink Glass Elemental has the ability to summon giant pink energy constructs from her cloud, which she used to summon a giant energy boot that threatened to crush me and a significant portion of the village.)
I used my cloud bursting abilities to destroy her cloud, and my Porta spell to banish her to a world without humans. (Cloud bursting isn't something I recall ever using in a prior dream. It is actually something I do from time to time when I'm outside. I find a cloud in the sky, focus on an imperfection in it, and I imagine the cloud breaking apart. I have videos of me doing this in which you can see the clouds actually dissipate on camera as I concentrate on them disappearing. It is honestly pretty cool that this works in my dreams as well, and that the main way I defeated Pink Glass Elemental is with a skill from the waking world. She was less defeated by the magic she finds superior, and more defeated by a human skill that I use in the waking world.)
